title: Find Two Non-Overlapping Sub-arrays Each With Target Sum
description: Find two non-overlapping sub-arrays each with a sum equal to target, minimizing the sum of their lengths.
pseudocode:
1. let n = arr.length, min_len = Infinity, res = Infinity
2. let left_min = new Array(n).fill(Infinity)
3. let sum = 0, map = {0: -1}
4. for i = 0 to n-1:
5.   sum += arr[i]
6.   if (sum - target) in map: min_len = min(min_len, i - map[sum - target])
7.   left_min[i] = min_len
8.   map[sum] = i
9. sum = 0, map = {0: n}
10. for i = n-1 down to 0:
11.  sum += arr[i]
12.  if (sum - target) in map:
13.    right_min = map[sum - target] - i
14.    if left_min[i-1] != Infinity: res = min(res, left_min[i-1] + right_min)
15.  map[sum] = i

steps.note: Starting forward pass to find shortest sub-array ending at or before i.
Found sub-array [1, 2] ending at index 1. min_len becomes 2.
Starting backward pass to find non-overlapping sub-array starting at or after i.
Check left_min[1] (2) + current sub-array length (2) = 4. Res = 4.
